confirmation: No labels/features/returns; any later full-period native counts separate from training-based selection; resolve governance before admission

gap_rules.major: Any run>=3 or serious source exception; reject after authentic mapping verified
gap_rules.minor: Only1–2 consecutive missing candles per run; candidate-only, no cleanup authority or inferred pass
gap_rules.native_clean: Genuine complete source and measured frozen feature/formation checks
gap_rules.terminal: Separate T2 blocker even when isolated

ordered_sector_rule: Skip represented sector; accept first fully qualifying distinct-sector name; candidate failure advances rank; five distinct sectors

proposed_historical_fallback.class_rule: Retain class with largest disclosed value per explicitly named issuer; tie ascending name. Do not aggregate other classes into its weight.
proposed_historical_fallback.rank: Descending disclosed fund holding USD value; exact ties ascending disclosed security name until verified stable IDs available
proposed_historical_fallback.weights: value / full505-common-stock total; exclude duplicate classes without renormalizing remaining weights
